publisher: City of Weirton (parcel layer with zoning codes)
notes: Brooke County has no county-wide zoning layer. City of Weirton parcel layer (built for the city Zoning Web Map) carrying each parcel zoning district in Combined_Zoning. Parcel polygons used as last resort; not a dedicated district layer. Covers only the Weirton part of Brooke County, not other Brooke municipalities.
